selection.objective: Expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar, including remaining cost, time, clinical risk and retained value
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether the existing BLU article/exposure and human-muscle route can produce an interpretable useful-function decision at bounded qualification scope
selection.basis: Next eligible source sprint after APR and RM closure, following the independent conditional order and checking specific fresh primary artifacts that could change the next commitment

decision: Complete and close this bounded BLU public-source pass. Retain affirmative staged article/exposure/model qualification and conditional human-function work, without a financial-rank promotion, paid commitment or execution authorization.
scientific_tier: Existing bounded qualification project; no S-tier promotion or new efficacy tier

independent_review.read_scope: Ten-page review recovered in Round16; BLU-specific objective, conditional order, two-stage budget, scope and promotion/stop passages rechecked in Round18

intended_first_claim: Useful on-treatment human muscle function in one qualified MTM1 background; preservation during maturation, reversal of an established deficit and respiratory benefit are distinct claims

conditional_function.scope: Conditional functional work after interpretable inputs

tranche_assumptions.status: Analyst planning assumptions; not quotes, validated schedules, all-in development budgets or probability estimates

completed_information_updates.finding: Official NDL/IRDB metadata links a Kyoto accepted-manuscript manifestation to the existing Kora Brain article. Metadata were read; manuscript content was not recovered. No new force, timing, donor or access qualification follows.

Inoue reports two muscle specimens with reduced respiratory-chain activity and one liver specimen with normal activity in two patients with liver involvement. This supports tissue-specific interpretation, not generalized liver reassurance or BLU injury/rescue.

The January2025 EXCEL notice describes prospective liver-focused observational work. Its planned participants and measurements supply a specific future evidence trigger, not current enrollment, results, data access or a new study to initiate.

Sponsor ASP2957 platform/dose-positioning and long-term follow-up planning add program specificity without a recovered clinical efficacy result, established safer exposure, validated residual market or direct BLU comparison.
The exact TAM4MTM update returns the prior termination/account and registry plans. No completed efficacy dataset was recovered and the old six-versus-seven denominator discrepancy remains unresolved.

marginal_value_judgment.positive_case: Strong carried-forward causal and exact-mouse rationale plus a specified first human-function question preserve a potentially valuable conditional qualification option.
marginal_value_judgment.limiting_case: The current public update does not qualify an exact human force route, establish a native exposure/selectivity window, verify actual project cost or demonstrate retained asset economics.
marginal_value_judgment.decision_after_this_information: Stop repeating generic public searches and preserve the finite staged decision. Reopen only for a substantive document/data/product fact capable of changing a named input.

routes.name: Bounded existing-article/exposure/model qualification
routes.question: Can one existing route yield an interpretable human useful-function decision without expanding into open-ended model or chemistry development?

routes.name: Conditional human-function comparison and independent confirmation
routes.question: Does useful force/fatigue improve at interpretable exposure in the selected background, and does that result justify confirmation and broader translation?

routes.name: Major new model, chemistry, systemic-window or rights program
routes.question: Do the actual added cost, delay, learning value and retained economics still outrank eligible alternatives and waiting?

branches.condition: A finite existing route can resolve the first human-function decision at credible cost/time
branches.decision: Retain the conditional qualification opportunity; require actual execution inputs before any later authorized run

branches.condition: A credible within-background functional positive is obtained with interpretable article/exposure and acceptable function
branches.decision: Independent confirmation can be justified without waiting for every causal-control or systemic module

branches.condition: The result is negative but article, exposure, deficit or precision is inadequate, or, for an intended reversal claim, post-deficit modifiability is inadequate
branches.decision: Classify the relevant result as inconclusive or redirect the deficient route; do not reject the target from an uninformative result

branches.condition: Qualification expands into major new model, chemistry, supply or rights work
branches.decision: Recompare actual incremental cost/time/information/capture against eligible alternatives and waiting; do not inherit the small-tranche label or historical allocation

branches.condition: Useful biology survives but relevant exposure safety, product contribution or retained economics is inadequate
branches.decision: Change article, narrow the product proposition, defer asset development or separately justify a scientific/public-benefit project

decision_inputs_remaining: Authenticated exact article and independently specified pharmacology
Reproducible qualified human force deficit and informative result interpretation
Intended population and relevant systemic/respiratory claim bridge
Actual finite qualification cost and time
Applicable exact-asset rights, access terms and retained economics

reopen_only_for: Accessible substantive Kora/Lionello methods or exact-line data resolving a named model input
New independent exact-article human functional evidence or an exact exposure/selectivity correction
Substantive disease-liver or competitor outcome data relevant to a specified population
A changed relevant claim/prosecution fact or newly identified exact-origin family under the existing Round12 stop rule
Concrete article/model/access/cost/transaction facts changing a finite next commitment
